reviews.review: A simple as i can say is just THANK YOU SO MUCH <3 <3 <3

Expected a horde shooter, but got dark souls

Pros:
- For the Emperor! Emperor protects
- Awesome graphics, sound quality
- Nice optimization. Game doesn't lag even when screen is filled with enemies
- Very interesting campaign. Really enjoyed it. Liked the characters, the plot, the conversations, the missions and gameplay. Super marines doing super marines stuff, loved it

N.B. I'll be honest: I've never played Dark Souls, though watched some gameplay. Initally came to this game from Helldivers 2. Expected kinda similar experience.

Cons: 
- Dark souls. You MUST parry and evade attacks almost all the time. You have fun, shoot the enemies. Skip one attack, dang! you are staggered, then you lose your armor and half of your health. You must learn all the patterns of enemies, when to block, what time to wait before blocking or jumping away. Sometimes you barely have any time to shoot even if you play as Heavy: you must swirl around, parry all the incoming attacks and somehow manage to kill enemies
- Can't enjoy because every game is a sweat. At least for me. You must lock in. One mistake and you lose all your health
- Game fails to explain basic things. Sometimes it's very unclear what I should do next. "Find the consoles", you press tab and nothing... How to they look? Where to look for them? "kill the boss" but you have to fire at the floating balls, why not just tell "shoot the balls"? Good luck with understanding all the mechanics of parrying and evading
- No test playground. All right you have all those enemies with so many different patterns. Give us a playground where we can spawn any enemies and train. "go play on lower difficulties". Nah, I tried, you don't have much possibilities with that. I wanna learn things one at a time
- Little ammo. With higher difficulties you get less and less. For some strange reason space marines can easily run with heavy armor and heavy guns but can't get a few additional mags. Yet all over the map there are crates with infinite ammo... Instead of filling enemies with bullets you do ammo optimization. Why not just give the players more ammo? Don't get it
- Very few stims. Less stims and less amount of hp restored with higher difficulties. Guess no one can supply 3 space marines on super important missions with a bunch of them. So you have to scavange for them
- Game is quite challenging even on the lowest difficulty. It was a giant frustration when on the 1st mission in PVE missions i died multiple times. The game punished you heavily for mistakes. I was very close to deleting the game, but came back
- Enemies get more health with higher difficulties. Instead of just raising amount of enemies... It makes the weapon upgrades less valuable. I prefer Helldivers 2 approach when all the enemies have the same amount of hp. You can just add more enemies or elite versions of the same enemies
- Stagger = death. I remember playing on the lowest difficulty as an assault. Lost armor and missed 1 single shot from tiranid majoris: -70% of health
- Loading screens. Loading into the game session screen, multiple lifts, heavy stones that, loading screen when you return back to the ship 
- Very strange armor and health restoration system. So almost all the time you just must perform unskippable animations of killing. Otherwise you won't properly get the armor back (i leave the perks that restore armor apart). Why can't I just kill enemies and get armor back? Why the only way to restore health is stims? What's the point of armor? I like those animations, but you MUST do them all the time, because otherwise you quickly die because you run out of health. I don't like to lose control over my character! Lemme just shoot and kill the enemies
- Imbalanced chaos. I dunno, but tyranids feel much more balanced. Against chaos I often find myself staggered to death. I hate that jumping piece of fur. I don't get its patterns. If you see 4 or 5 around yourself you just die. They stagger you till death
- Not much teamwork. Didn't feel any sinergy with other players. Doesn't matter that much whether you play alone or not. Just some enemies get distracted by other players and that makes the game a bit easier

Additional
- Didn't try PVP. Came for pve. So can't say anything about it
- Didn't try sieges. Was feared of that

REALLY GOOD GAME, ANIMATION, COMBAT ECT. HOWEVER THERE ARE ISSUES.

Either the game is horribly optimized and runs like a freight train on fire, or my pc is bad. Probably a mix of both, either way, I wouldn't spend $60 on a glorified PS3 game. (Literally, Metal Gear Rising looks better 99% of the time)

Loading times and the operation of the mission select screens are really bad. Not to mention that damn elevator in the docking bay, where you'll spend all your time in outside of missions.

Warhammer fans are notorious for spending a ♥♥♥♥ ton of money on a cruddy product (Guilty as charged)
and this is just another example of it.

This game is so shallow and underwhelming, both from combat and story perspective that after completing main campaign I feel like I'll never run it again. Definitely wouldn't recommend it to anyone I guess other than hardcore fans of the franchise.
INTO THE FIRES OF BATTLE UNTO THE ANVIL OF WARRRRRR!!!!!!!!!!
